requestedText: Add the bounded official-research candidate registry used by the reference-model live run.

evidence: The candidate registry is static repository-local JSON consumed by the existing configuration loader; it does not resolve code, credentials, plugins, or dynamic dispatch.
The registry is a bounded Weekly Radar research input and introduces no external consumer migration surface.
The registry contains source configuration only and introduces no monitoring, scheduler, webhook, or alerting integration.
The Contract bounds this registry to explicit official sources, forbids guessed URLs and unbounded crawling, and requires the live evidence matrix to remain fail-closed.
